tools.name: search_games
tools.description: Find web games from a natural-language query plus optional filters (genre, mood, session length, players, quality, content rating, difficulty, inputs). Phrases like 'for kids', '2 player', 'under 10 minutes', 'not a shooter', 'easy' or 'chill' are turned into filters (echoed as interpreted_filters);

tools.name: get_game
tools.description: Full details of one game by id or {slug}-{id}. Aliased ids resolve to the canonical game (requested_id is set). tools.name: random_game
tools.description: One random eligible game for 'surprise me' flows; pass seed for a deterministic pick. Never returns Mature games. Zero eligible games gives game: null with code NO_MATCHES and relaxations.

tools.name: new_games
tools.description: Games published in the last 30 days, newest first. Returns only published, playable games verified within the last 8 days (listing-only games with include_listing_only=true; plays=here or plays=developer_site picks one kind). content_rating_max defaults to teen. Zero results is a success with code N

tools.name: play_game
tools.description: Play an ArcadeIndex game right inside the chat. Pass game_id (an id, {slug}-{id}, or a game's url from search_games, trending, games_like or new_games results) or query (the top search hit is played; a game that only plays on its developer's site comes back as link_out). findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "play_game" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Play an ArcadeIndex game right inside the chat. Pass game_id (an id, {slug}-{id}, or a game's url from search_games, trending, games_like or new_games results) …

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "play_game" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.
